radar-ast.description: Advanced Codebase Radar. Performs AST-based structural analysis, multi-file skeleton mapping, and local LLM logic summarization. Best for deep architectural research and large file triage.

cargo-db.description: Smart SQL Introspection. Provides schema visualization, join-path discovery, and query explanation. Use for database design and performance tuning.

debug-probe.description: Diagnostic Execution Probe. Runs commands safely, tails/filters logs in real-time, and performs local AI crash analysis. Primary tool for CI/CD debugging and runtime troubleshooting.

doc-scribe.description: Documentation & Token Optimizer. Manages Markdown via deterministic structural patching and offloads summarization/docstring generation to local models. Mandatory for maintaining docs without burning Cloud AI quota.

view-port.description: Frontend Structural Radar. Inspects design tokens, maps component props, strips DOM noise, and navigates routes. Crucial for token-efficient UI/UX development without LLM overhead.
